post_headline: Level your rig from your wrist.
post_subline: Set your iPhone inside and watch the level on Apple Watch. It shows which side to raise.
caption:
Don't wait for the eggs to slide to one side of the pan.
Set your iPhone on the counter and watch the level on your Apple Watch, from the jacks or the cab of your truck.
Free on the App Store. Link in bio.
